title: Restriction Coefficient Observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, and let $J\\subseteq[n]$ and $S\\subseteq J$. Fix signs $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$ and signs $y$ on $J$. The restriction coefficient observation is the value of $f$ on the combined sign assignment, multiplied by the character indexed by $S$ evaluated at $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
